rules.name: SHACKLE-1:no_human_harm
rules.reason: SHACKLE-1: never execute an action expected to physically harm a human.

rules.name: SHACKLE-2:no_hostile_action
rules.reason: SHACKLE-2: the platform must not be used to attack or as a weapon.

rules.name: SHACKLE-3:no_operator_deception
rules.reason: SHACKLE-3: never deceive or conceal state from the human operator.

rules.name: SHACKLE-4:no_public_repo_without_consent
rules.reason: SHACKLE-4: never let a specialist write to a public GitHub repo without an explicit consent_given tag.

rules.name: SHACKLE-5:no_irreversible_without_review
rules.reason: SHACKLE-5: irreversible or destructive actions require an explicit reversible=true acknowledgement or human review.

rules.name: SHACKLE-6:forbid_production_environment_writes
rules.reason: SHACKLE-6: this action's environment is on the forbidden list (e.g. writes gated out of 'production' by policy).
